ex.en: My grandmother enjoys gardening on cool spring mornings.
ex.zh: 我奶奶喜欢在凉爽的春日早晨打理花园。

ex.en: Community gardening can improve urban environments while helping residents develop stronger social connections.
ex.zh: 社区园艺既能改善城市环境，也能帮助居民建立更紧密的社会联系。

tip: 通常为不可数名词：do some gardening。

senses.en: the activity of telling or reading stories aloud to listeners

ex.en: Our class enjoys storytelling time every Friday afternoon in the library.
ex.zh: 我们班每周五下午在图书馆都很享受讲故事时间。

ex.en: The cultural center holds a storytelling event where grandparents share old folk tales with children.
ex.zh: 文化中心举办了一场讲故事活动，祖父母们在活动中给孩子们讲古老的民间故事。

tip: 由story（故事）和telling（讲述）合并构成不可数名词，中间不加空格。

ex.en: My sister enjoys photography and carries her camera everywhere.
ex.zh: 我姐姐喜欢摄影，走到哪儿都带着相机。

ex.en: Digital photography allows researchers to document environmental changes and share visual evidence with a wider audience.
ex.zh: 数码摄影让研究人员能够记录环境变化，并向更广泛的受众分享影像证据。

col: take up photography｜开始学习摄影
tip: photography不可数；一张照片用a photograph。

ex.en: Would you like to join us for lunch today?
ex.zh: 你今天愿意和我们一起吃午饭吗？

ex.en: Students who join local volunteer groups can develop practical skills while contributing to their communities.
ex.zh: 加入当地志愿者团体的学生可以在服务社区的同时培养实用技能。

tip: join a club指加入组织；join in指参与活动。

senses.en: what you can see from a particular place, especially beautiful scenery

ex.en: From our hotel window, we can see a lovely sea view.
ex.zh: 从我们酒店的窗户望出去，可以看到迷人的海景。

ex.en: When we climbed to the top of Wutong Mountain, the city view below looked amazing.
ex.zh: 当我们爬上梧桐山山顶时，山下的城市景色看起来非常壮观。

tip: 这里指眼睛看到的自然或城市风景，常见搭配为enjoy the view。

ex.en: The market stall displayed pottery in soft earthy colours.
ex.zh: 市场摊位上陈列着色调柔和、带有泥土色泽的陶器。

ex.en: Traditional pottery can reveal how earlier societies stored food, traded goods, and expressed their cultural identity.
ex.zh: 传统陶器能够揭示早期社会如何储存食物、交易商品以及表达文化身份。

tip: 指陶器统称时不可数；一件用a piece of pottery。

senses.en: used to make a friendly suggestion or ask someone's opinion

ex.en: I want to play football today; how about flying a kite tomorrow?
ex.zh: 我今天想踢足球，明天去放风筝怎么样？

ex.en: After finishing our science homework, how about visiting the botanical garden to see the flowers?
ex.zh: 做完科学作业后，去植物园看花怎么样？

col: how about going swimming｜去游泳怎么样
how about this one｜这个怎么样
tip: 用于提出建议或征询意见，about是介词，后面接名词或动词-ing形式。

ex.en: We took a photo beside the old bridge.
ex.zh: 我们在那座老桥旁拍了张照片。

ex.en: Historical photos provide valuable evidence of how urban landscapes and everyday lifestyles have changed over time.
ex.zh: 历史照片为研究城市景观和日常生活方式如何随时间变化提供了宝贵证据。

tip: photo是photograph的常用简称；复数为photos。

ex.en: Wait a moment while I put my shoes on.
ex.zh: 等一会儿，我穿上鞋就好。

ex.en: The opening of the new railway marked a significant moment in the region's economic development.
ex.zh: 新铁路的开通标志着该地区经济发展中的一个重要时刻。

col: in a moment｜马上；一会儿后
a turning point moment｜转折时刻
tip: at the moment指现在；in a moment指马上。

ex.en: We spent the afternoon making art with coloured paper.
ex.zh: 我们花了一下午用彩纸创作艺术作品。

ex.en: Public funding for art can enrich community life and make cultural experiences accessible to a wider audience.
ex.zh: 公共艺术资助能丰富社区生活，让更多人有机会体验文化活动。

col: a work of art｜一件艺术作品
the art of conversation｜交谈的艺术
tip: art指艺术通常不可数；一件作品用a work of art。

ex.en: Helping strangers without expecting rewards is a noble act.
ex.zh: 帮助陌生人而不求回报是一种高尚的行为。

ex.en: Although reducing poverty is a noble goal, effective policies require sustained funding and careful evaluation.
ex.zh: 虽然减贫是崇高的目标，但有效的政策需要持续的资金支持和审慎的评估。

tip: 表示“高尚的”时强调品德，而非社会地位。

senses.en: to use a camera or phone to make pictures of people or things

ex.en: Dad likes to take photos of cute birds in the park.
ex.zh: 爸爸喜欢在公园里给可爱的小鸟拍照片。

ex.en: During our spring trip to the museum, students can take photos of ancient pottery.
ex.zh: 在春游去博物馆期间，同学们可以给古代陶器拍照。

col: take photos of flowers｜给花拍照
like to take photos｜喜欢拍照
take clear photos｜拍出清晰的照片
tip: 注意photo的复数是直接加-s，而不是加-es，常见搭配为take photos of。

senses.en: the scenery of a place seen in the dark when lights are on

ex.en: We love watching the night view of Shenzhen from Lianhua Hill.
ex.zh: 我们喜欢从莲花山上看深圳的夜景。

ex.en: Many visitors stand by the river to admire the night view of the tall shining buildings.
ex.zh: 许多游客站在河边，欣赏高大闪亮建筑的夜景。

col: enjoy the night view of｜欣赏……的夜景
the night view of the city｜城市的夜景
tip: 后面必须接地点名词，表示“某地的夜景”，如the night view of Shenzhen。

ex.en: We cooked a traditional meal for the family gathering.
ex.zh: 我们为家庭聚会做了一顿传统饭菜。

ex.en: Traditional farming methods can preserve local knowledge, although some require adaptation to cope with climate change.
ex.zh: 传统耕作方法能够保留地方知识，但其中一些需要调整以应对气候变化。

tip: traditional强调传承已久，不一定表示落后。

senses.en: a traditional Chinese toy spun on a string held by two sticks

ex.en: Grandpa teaches me how to spin a Chinese yo-yo in the yard.
ex.zh: 爷爷在院子里教我怎么抖空竹。

ex.en: At the school folk sports show, older students threw a Chinese yo-yo high into the air.
ex.zh: 在学校民间体育展演上，高年级同学把空竹高高抛向空中。

col: play with a Chinese yo-yo｜抖空竹
spin a Chinese yo-yo｜转动空竹
a red Chinese yo-yo｜一个红空竹
tip: Chinese首字母必须大写，yo-yo中间有连字符，是中国传统民间玩具。

senses.en: the outdoor activity of holding a string to fly a kite in the wind

ex.en: Windy spring afternoons are the best time for kite-flying outside.
ex.zh: 有风的春日午后是到户外放风筝的最佳时间。

ex.en: The city park holds a colorful kite-flying festival every April near the wide grassy hill.
ex.zh: 城市公园每年四月都会在宽阔的草坡附近举办多彩的风筝节。

col: kite-flying weather｜适合放风筝的天气
tip: 这是一个复合名词，表示“放风筝”这项活动，中间通常带连字符。

senses.en: a traditional Chinese performance where people hold up a long dragon model and dance

ex.en: We watched an exciting dragon dance on the street during Spring Festival.
ex.zh: 春节期间我们在街上观看了精彩的舞龙表演。

ex.en: Ten strong performers moved together smoothly to make the dragon dance look lively and powerful.
ex.zh: 十位有力的表演者配合默契，让舞龙看起来生动又有气势。

col: perform a dragon dance｜表演舞龙
tip: 表示“舞龙”这一传统民俗表演，常与watch或perform搭配使用。

senses.en: a team game where two groups pull opposite ends of a long rope

ex.en: Our class won the tug of war game on sports day.
ex.zh: 我们班在运动会上的拔河比赛中赢了。

ex.en: In tug of war, every student pulls hard together on the thick rope to help the team.
ex.zh: 在拔河比赛中，每位同学都齐心协力拉紧粗绳子来帮助团队获胜。

col: a tug of war match｜一场拔河比赛
win the tug of war｜赢得拔河比赛
tip: tug本意为“用力拉”，tug of war直接指拔河比赛，不可数。

senses.en: a children's game of hopping through numbered squares drawn on the ground

ex.en: Girls drew chalk squares and played hopscotch in the schoolyard.
ex.zh: 女孩们用粉笔画了方格，在校园里玩跳房子。

ex.en: During break time, students throw a small stone and hop carefully while playing hopscotch together.
ex.zh: 课间休息时，同学们扔出一颗小石子，在一边玩跳房子一边小心单脚跳。

col: a hopscotch grid｜跳房子格子图
tip: 表示游戏名称时前面不加the，直接说play hopscotch即可。

senses.en: to press a mark, date, or pattern onto paper using an inked tool

ex.en: The librarian will stamp today's date inside my borrowed book.
ex.zh: 图书管理员会在我借的书里盖上今天的日期章。

ex.en: At the nature museum, children can stamp their little passports at each animal exhibition hall.
ex.zh: 在自然博物馆里，孩子们可以在每个动物展厅给自己的小护照盖章。

col: stamp a card｜在卡片上盖章
stamp a passport｜在护照上盖印
tip: 作动词时意为“盖章、盖印”，注意不要与名词“邮票”的意思混淆。

ex.en: Lina won a prize for her colourful garden.
ex.zh: 莉娜因她色彩缤纷的花园获了奖。

ex.en: Offering a prize for innovative designs can encourage students to develop practical solutions to environmental problems.
ex.zh: 为创新设计设奖，可以鼓励学生提出解决环境问题的实用方案。

tip: prize可作动词表珍视，常见be highly prized。

ex.en: Her colourful paintings have a cheerful, playful style.
ex.zh: 她色彩丰富的画作有一种欢快、俏皮的风格。

ex.en: Modern architects often adapt traditional building styles to preserve local identity while meeting contemporary housing needs.
ex.zh: 现代建筑师常改良传统建筑风格，在满足当代住房需求的同时保留地方特色。

col: style your hair｜给头发做造型
tip: style可指个人风格，不一定表示流行时尚。

senses.en: a physical movement made by a person's body, hands, or feet

ex.en: Follow my hand action when we sing this happy English song.
ex.zh: 我们唱这首快乐的英文歌时，请跟着做我的手部动作。

ex.en: In kung fu class, every slow arm action needs good balance and careful breathing.
ex.zh: 在功夫课上，每一个缓慢的手臂动作都需要良好的平衡和仔细的呼吸配合。

col: a quick action｜一个快速的动作
copy the action｜模仿这个动作
tip: 这里指身体做出的具体动作，作为可数名词时复数为actions。

ex.en: Use a ruler to draw a straight line.
ex.zh: 用尺子画一条直线。

ex.en: Building straight roads across mountainous regions can be expensive and may damage natural habitats.
ex.zh: 在山区修建笔直的道路可能成本高昂，还可能破坏自然栖息地。

col: a straight answer｜直截了当的回答
tip: straight本身可作副词，不用加-ly。

senses.en: to move or learn at the same speed as someone or something else

ex.en: Slow down a bit so your little sister can keep up with you.
ex.zh: 走慢一点，好让你的小妹妹能跟上你。

ex.en: Although the mountain path was steep, Leo tried hard to keep up with the hiking team.
ex.zh: 虽然山路很陡，但利奥努力跟上徒步队伍。

col: keep up with the class｜跟上班级进度
keep up with friends｜跟上朋友们
hard to keep up with｜很难跟上
tip: 固定三词短语，既可指跑步速度“跟上”，也可指学习进度“跟得上”。

ex.en: Keep control of the kite by holding the string firmly.
ex.zh: 抓紧风筝线，控制好风筝。

ex.en: Stricter control of industrial emissions could improve air quality and reduce health risks in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 更严格地控制工业排放可以改善空气质量，并降低人口密集城市的健康风险。

tip: 过去式controlled、现在分词controlling均双写l。

ex.en: We slowed our pace so Grandma could catch up.
ex.zh: 我们放慢脚步，好让奶奶跟上。

ex.en: The rapid pace of technological change requires workers to update their skills throughout their careers.
ex.zh: 技术变革的快速步伐要求劳动者在整个职业生涯中不断更新技能。

col: at your own pace｜按自己的节奏
the pace of change｜变化的速度
pace up and down｜来回踱步
tip: 按某种速度用at a ... pace；keep pace with指跟上。

ex.en: The soup was excellent, so I ordered another bowl.
ex.zh: 这汤好喝极了，所以我又点了一碗。

ex.en: Excellent public transport can reduce car dependence and make cities more accessible to all residents.
ex.zh: 优质的公共交通可以减少人们对汽车的依赖，让所有居民出行更便利。

tip: 已含“极好”之意，通常不用very修饰。

ex.en: This cup is cracked, so please bring me another.
ex.zh: 这个杯子裂了，请再给我拿一个。

ex.en: Another reason to invest in public transport is its potential to reduce urban air pollution.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通的另一个理由是，它有望减少城市空气污染。

tip: 通常接单数名词；another two days表示再两天。

ex.en: Everyone joined the dance, even our shy uncle.
ex.zh: 大家都加入了舞蹈，连我们害羞的叔叔也不例外。

ex.en: Even small improvements in public transport can make daily travel easier for people with limited mobility.
ex.zh: 即使公共交通只有小幅改善，也能让行动不便者的日常出行更加轻松。

tip: even if表假设“即使”；even though表事实“尽管”。

ex.en: I always lose my keys inside this enormous bag.
ex.zh: 我总是在这个大包里找不到钥匙。

ex.en: Small businesses may lose customers when major retailers offer similar products at significantly lower prices.
ex.zh: 大型零售商以低得多的价格提供类似产品时，小企业可能会流失顾客。

tip: 过去式和过去分词都是lost；别与loose混淆。

senses.en: to practice a skill or sport regularly so you get better at it

ex.en: The swimming team members train hard in the pool every afternoon.
ex.zh: 游泳队的队员们每天下午都在泳池里刻苦训练。

ex.en: Before the city sports meeting, our school runners train on the track for an hour.
ex.zh: 在市运动会开始前，我们学校的跑步选手在跑道上训练一小时。

col: train for a race｜为比赛训练
tip: 这里train作动词表示“训练”，注意区别于作名词时的“火车”。

senses.en: a traditional northern Chinese martial art style known for long, sweeping movements

ex.en: My cousin practices changquan in the morning with his sports coach.
ex.zh: 我表哥早上和体育教练一起练长拳。

ex.en: At the school martial arts show, students performed changquan with wide kicks and strong punches.
ex.zh: 在学校武术展演上，同学们表演了动作舒展有力、踢腿出拳的长拳。

tip: 中国传统武术“长拳”的音译词，在句中通常作不可数名词使用。

senses.en: moving with very great speed, just like wind blowing quickly

ex.en: When the race started, Mia ran as fast as the wind.
ex.zh: 比赛开始时，米娅跑得像风一样快。

ex.en: Across the open grassland, the cheetah chases its food and runs as fast as the wind.
ex.zh: 在开阔的草原上，猎豹追逐食物时跑得像风一样快。

col: run as fast as the wind｜跑得像风一样快
ride as fast as the wind｜骑得像风一样快
tip: as...as结构表示“和……一样”，中间用形容词或副词原级fast。

senses.en: to cooperate together with other people to finish a job or win

ex.en: We can clean the whole classroom quickly if we work as a team.
ex.zh: 如果我们团队合作，就能很快把整间教室打扫干净。

ex.en: Building a tall paper tower in science class teaches students how to work as a team.
ex.zh: 在科学课上搭建高高的纸塔教会了学生们如何团队合作。

col: learn to work as a team｜学会团队合作
work as a team to win｜团队合作去赢
tip: as在此处意为“作为”，整个短语表示“作为一个团队共同协作”。

senses.en: to become active, lively, or healthy again after being quiet or weak

ex.en: After we water the dry flowers, they soon come to life.
ex.zh: 我们给干燥的花儿浇水后，它们很快就恢复了生气。

ex.en: When warm spring rain falls on the forest, sleeping plants and trees quickly come to life.
ex.zh: 当温暖的春雨落在森林里时，沉睡的植物和树木很快恢复了生气。

col: come to life again｜重新恢复生机
slowly come to life｜慢慢恢复生气
plants come to life｜植物焕发生机
tip: life指生命和活力，整个短语常用来形容植物、公园等重新充满生机。

ex.en: Thick roots from the oak have cracked our garden path.
ex.zh: 橡树粗壮的根把我们花园的小路撑裂了。

ex.en: Effective policies should address the root of poverty rather than simply provide temporary financial assistance.
ex.zh: 有效的政策应解决贫困的根源，而不只是提供临时的经济援助。

col: at the root of｜是……的根源
tip: root本身不表示根除；root out才表示根除。

senses.en: to breathe air into your lungs or absorb water and nutrients

ex.en: Stand outside and take in a deep breath of fresh air.
ex.zh: 站到外面，深深吸入一口新鲜空气。

ex.en: Green leaves use sunlight to take in carbon dioxide from the air and make food.
ex.zh: 绿叶利用阳光从空气中吸入二氧化碳并制造养分。

col: take in fresh air｜吸入新鲜空气
tip: 可表示人或动物“吸入空气”，在科普文中也常表示植物“吸收养分”。

ex.en: She cut the rose stem before filling the vase.
ex.zh: 她先修剪了玫瑰的花茎，再给花瓶加水。

ex.en: Many urban transport problems stem from poor planning rather than a simple shortage of road space.
ex.zh: 许多城市交通问题源于规划不善，而不只是道路空间不足。

col: stem the flow of｜遏制…的流动
stem the tide of｜遏制…的势头
tip: “源于”用stem from；大写STEM指理工科。

ex.en: She wrapped a thick blanket around her cold shoulders.
ex.zh: 她把一条厚毯子裹在冰冷的肩膀上。

ex.en: Thick layers of insulation can reduce heat loss and lower household energy bills during winter.
ex.zh: 厚厚的隔热层可以减少热量流失，降低冬季家庭能源开支。

tip: 形容液体时指黏稠，不一定表示味道浓。

senses.en: a water plant with round floating leaves and pretty flowers on a pond

ex.en: A pink water lily is floating quietly on the school pond.
ex.zh: 一朵粉色的睡莲正静静地漂浮在学校池塘上。

ex.en: Every morning in summer, the white water lily opens its bright petals to face the sun.
ex.zh: 在夏天的每个清晨，白色的睡莲都会向着太阳张开明亮的花瓣。

col: a pink water lily｜一朵粉红睡莲
tip: 复数形式需要把lily中的y变为i再加es，即water lilies。

ex.en: How did your sister react to the surprise party?
ex.zh: 你姐姐对这场惊喜派对有什么反应？

ex.en: Governments must react quickly to public health emergencies while providing clear information to citizens.
ex.zh: 政府必须迅速应对公共卫生紧急事件，同时向公众提供清晰的信息。

col: react to news｜对消息作出反应
tip: 对某事反应用react to；与物质反应用react with。

senses.en: the hard, brown, egg-shaped fruit of a pine tree that holds its seeds

ex.en: I picked up a brown pine cone under the tall tree.
ex.zh: 我在高大的树下捡起了一个棕色的松果。

ex.en: In autumn, squirrels collect seeds from every dry pine cone before the cold winter comes.
ex.zh: 在秋天，松鼠会在寒冷的冬天到来前从干燥的松果里收集种子。

col: a dry pine cone｜一个干松果
paint a pine cone｜给松果涂色
tip: pine指松树，cone指圆锥体，松果形状像圆锥，因此合称pine cone。

senses.en: one of the small flat hard pieces covering the skin of a fish, snake, or pine cone

ex.en: Look at how each shiny scale covers the red goldfish's body.
ex.zh: 看一看每一片闪亮的鳞片是如何覆盖在红金鱼身上的。

ex.en: Our science teacher showed us how a pine cone opens each wooden scale on dry days.
ex.zh: 科学老师向我们展示了松果是如何在干燥的日子里张开每一片木质鳞片的。

tip: 表示鱼、蛇或松果上的“鳞片”时通常是可数名词，常以复数scales出现。

senses.en: a climbing plant with trumpet-shaped flowers that usually open early in the morning

ex.en: Purple morning glory flowers climb all over our garden fence.
ex.zh: 紫色的牵牛花爬满了我们花园的栅栏。

ex.en: In the school garden, the morning glory opens its blue blossoms early and closes by noon.
ex.zh: 在学校花园里，牵牛花一早便绽放蓝色花朵，到中午就合拢了。

col: climbing morning glory｜攀爬的牵牛花
tip: 牵牛花在清晨迎着朝阳开放，所以英文形象地称它为“早晨的荣耀”。

ex.en: I wore a thin jacket and felt cold outside.
ex.zh: 我穿了件薄外套，在外面觉得冷。

ex.en: Thin layers of insulation can improve energy efficiency without significantly reducing the usable space inside buildings.
ex.zh: 薄层隔热材料能提高能源效率，同时不会明显减少建筑内部的可用空间。

tip: 形容身材时，thin不一定褒义；slim通常含赞美。

ex.en: Wear thick gloves to protect your hands from thorns.
ex.zh: 戴上厚手套，保护双手不被刺扎伤。

ex.en: Governments should protect endangered species by preserving natural habitats and restricting activities that threaten their survival.
ex.zh: 政府应通过保护自然栖息地并限制威胁生存的活动，来保护濒危物种。

col: protect from harm｜保护……免受伤害
tip: 常用protect sb/sth from或against，表示免受伤害。

ex.en: She filled the pot with soil and planted seeds.
ex.zh: 她往花盆里填了土，然后种下种子。

ex.en: Intensive farming can damage soil quality, reducing the land's ability to support crops over time.
ex.zh: 集约化农业可能损害土壤质量，逐渐降低土地种植作物的能力。

tip: 土壤一般不可数；不同土质可用复数soils。

senses.en: a flat, usually green part of a plant growing from a stem or branch

ex.en: A small green leaf fell slowly onto my open notebook.
ex.zh: 一片小小的绿叶慢慢落到了我打开的笔记本上。

ex.en: In autumn, we collect each yellow maple leaf to make pretty bookmarks in art class.
ex.zh: 在秋天，我们收集每一片黄色的枫叶，在美术课上做漂亮的书签。

tip: leaf变复数时要注意去f变v再加es，变成leaves，发音为/liːvz/。

senses.en: a plant that grows along the ground or climbs up walls and trees

ex.en: A green creeper grows slowly up the side of our school wall.
ex.zh: 一株绿色的攀缘植物正沿着我们学校的墙壁慢慢向上生长。

ex.en: In the rainforest, a strong creeper winds around tall tree trunks to reach the bright sunlight.
ex.zh: 在热带雨林里，一株强壮的攀缘植物缠绕着高大的树干向上生长以获取阳光。

col: a green creeper｜一株绿色攀缘植物
tip: 动词creep意为“爬行、蔓延”，加上-er就表示“会爬墙蔓生的植物”。

senses.en: a bright spring flower shaped like a cup on top of a tall stem

ex.en: Mom planted ten yellow tulip bulbs in our sunny front yard.
ex.zh: 妈妈在我们阳光充足的前院种了十颗黄色郁金香花球。

ex.en: Every spring, visitors walk through the flower park to admire rows of red and pink tulips.
ex.zh: 每年春天，游客们都会走过花卉公园，欣赏一排排红色和粉色的郁金香。

col: a red tulip｜一朵红郁金香
tip: 可数名词，复数为tulips，注意英式读音带/j/，美式常省去/j/读/ˈtuːlɪp/。

senses.en: a special plant that catches and digests insects or tiny animals for food

ex.en: We saw a strange meat-eating plant at the science museum.
ex.zh: 我们在科学博物馆看到了一株奇特的食肉植物。

ex.en: In nature class, we learned how a meat-eating plant uses sweet smell to catch hungry flies.
ex.zh: 在自然课上，我们了解到食肉植物是如何用甜味来捕捉饥饿的苍蝇的。

col: a strange meat-eating plant｜一株奇特的食肉植物
grow a meat-eating plant｜种植食肉植物
tip: meat-eating中间有连字符构成合成形容词，意为“吃肉的、食肉的”。

senses.en: a large outdoor park where wild animals move freely and visitors drive through to watch them

ex.en: Our family plans to visit the safari park this sunny Saturday.
ex.zh: 我们家计划这个阳光明媚的周六去参观野生动物园。

ex.en: At Shenzhen Safari Park, students can watch giraffes and zebras walking freely across open fields.
ex.zh: 在深圳野生动物园，同学们可以看到长颈鹿和斑马在开阔的草地上自由走动。

col: visit a safari park｜参观野生动物园
go to the safari park｜去野生动物园
wildlife in the safari park｜野生动物园里的动物
tip: safari park比普通的zoo更大，动物可在开阔地带自由活动，重音在fa上。

ex.en: The tiger rested in the shade beside a pool.
ex.zh: 那只老虎在水池旁的阴凉处休息。

ex.en: Protecting tiger habitats also helps conserve other species that share the same forest ecosystems.
ex.zh: 保护老虎栖息地也有助于保护同一森林生态系统中的其他物种。

tip: 可数名词；一只老虎用a tiger。

ex.en: The lion rested beneath a tree in the shade.
ex.zh: 那头狮子在树荫下休息。

ex.en: Protecting lions requires large habitats where they can hunt naturally without coming into conflict with farmers.
ex.zh: 保护狮子需要大片栖息地，让它们能够自然捕猎而不与农民发生冲突。

col: a pride of lions｜一群狮子
tip: 狮群用a pride of lions；母狮称lioness。

ex.en: The rising river poses a threat to our village.
ex.zh: 不断上涨的河水对我们村庄构成威胁。

ex.en: Habitat destruction remains a major threat to biodiversity, particularly in regions experiencing rapid agricultural expansion.
ex.zh: 栖息地破坏仍是生物多样性面临的重大威胁，在农业迅速扩张的地区尤其如此。

col: pose a threat to｜对……构成威胁
tip: 名词用 threat；动词用 threaten。

ex.en: A whale surfaced beside our boat and sprayed water.
ex.zh: 一头鲸在我们船旁浮出水面，喷出了水雾。

ex.en: Protecting whale populations requires international cooperation because these marine mammals migrate across vast areas of ocean.
ex.zh: 保护鲸类种群需要国际合作，因为这些海洋哺乳动物会跨越广阔海域迁徙。

tip: 鲸是哺乳动物，不是鱼；复数通常为whales。

ex.en: There is a little sand stuck between my toes.
ex.zh: 我的脚趾缝里沾了一点沙子。

ex.en: Wearing shoes that restrict toe movement may affect balance and contribute to foot problems over time.
ex.zh: 穿限制脚趾活动的鞋子可能影响平衡，长此以往还可能导致足部问题。

col: stub your toe｜脚趾撞到硬物
from head to toe｜从头到脚
tip: 手指是finger，脚趾是toe；大脚趾用big toe。

ex.en: Wear thick gloves to protect your hands from thorns.
ex.zh: 戴上厚手套，保护双手不被刺扎伤。

ex.en: Governments should protect endangered species by preserving natural habitats and restricting activities that threaten their survival.
ex.zh: 政府应通过保护自然栖息地并限制威胁生存的活动，来保护濒危物种。

col: protect from harm｜保护……免受伤害
tip: 常用protect sb/sth from或against，表示免受伤害。

senses.en: a sightseeing trip where visitors ride inside a big truck to see animals or places

ex.en: We took a fun truck tour through the lion area today.
ex.zh: 我们今天乘车参加了一场穿越狮子区的有趣卡车游览。

ex.en: During the safari park truck tour, the guide told us many stories about giant giraffes.
ex.zh: 在野生动物园的卡车游览期间，导游给我们讲了许多关于高大长颈鹿的故事。

col: take a truck tour｜参加卡车游览
a safe truck tour｜安全的卡车观光
truck tour guide｜卡车游览导游
tip: truck是卡车，tour是观光游览，连用指乘坐观光卡车游览动物园。

ex.en: The giraffe stretched its neck to reach the highest leaves.
ex.zh: 那只长颈鹿伸长脖子去够最高处的叶子。

ex.en: Protecting natural habitats is essential for maintaining healthy giraffe populations and preserving biodiversity in African grasslands.
ex.zh: 保护自然栖息地对于维持健康的长颈鹿种群和保护非洲草原的生物多样性至关重要。

col: a herd of giraffes｜一群长颈鹿
tip: 重音在第二音节，复数通常加-s。

senses.en: a person whose job is to take care of animals in a zoo or park

ex.en: The kind keeper feeds fresh bamboo to the pandas every morning.
ex.zh: 善良的饲养员每天早上都会给熊猫喂新鲜的竹子。

ex.en: A zoo keeper checks the elephants' health daily and makes sure their pool stays clean.
ex.zh: 动物园饲养员每天检查大象的健康状况，并确保它们的水池保持干净。

col: a zoo keeper｜动物园饲养员
tip: 由动词keep（照料、饲养）加后缀-er构成，表示“照顾动物的人”。

senses.en: to move near someone or something

ex.en: Do not get close to the tiger cage at the zoo.
ex.zh: 在动物园里不要靠近老虎笼子。

ex.en: On the nature walk, students walked quietly so they could get close to the butterflies.
ex.zh: 在自然漫步时，同学们轻手轻脚地走着，以便靠近那些蝴蝶。

col: get close to nature｜亲近大自然
never get close to｜千万不要靠近
get close to the animals｜靠近动物
tip: 这里的close读作/kləʊs/，作形容词表示“近的”，不要读成动词/kləʊz/。

ex.en: She tied her hair back before making lunch.
ex.zh: 她做午饭前把头发扎了起来。

ex.en: Some workplaces are relaxing rules about hair and clothing to create a more inclusive environment.
ex.zh: 一些工作场所正在放宽对发型和服装的规定，以营造更包容的环境。

col: a strand of hair｜一缕头发
tip: 整体头发不可数；一根头发用a hair。

senses.en: a very large grey African animal with a huge mouth that lives near rivers

ex.en: A big grey hippo is resting in the cool river water.
ex.zh: 一只大灰河马正在凉爽的河水里休息。

ex.en: Although a hippo looks heavy and slow, it can run fast on land and swim well.
ex.zh: 虽然河马看起来又重又慢，但它在陆地上能跑得很快，而且很会游泳。

col: a huge hippo｜一只巨大的河马
hippo in the river｜河里的河马
tip: hippo是hippopotamus的简写，变复数时直接加-s，写成hippos。

ex.en: We watched a swimmer dive smoothly into the pool.
ex.zh: 我们看着一名游泳者流畅地跃入泳池。

ex.en: Tourists who dive near coral reefs should avoid touching marine organisms to prevent damage to fragile ecosystems.
ex.zh: 在珊瑚礁附近潜水的游客应避免触碰海洋生物，以免破坏脆弱的生态系统。

col: dive into the water｜跃入水中
tip: 过去式英式常用dived，美式也用dove。

ex.en: We took a guided tour of the old castle.
ex.zh: 我们在导游带领下参观了那座古堡。

ex.en: Organized tours can introduce visitors to local traditions while providing reliable income for community guides.
ex.zh: 有组织的游览既能让游客了解当地传统，也能为社区导游提供稳定收入。

col: guided tour｜有导游带领的游览
go on tour｜进行巡回活动
tip: tour强调参观或多站行程；trip泛指一次出行。

ex.en: I write in my diary before going to bed.
ex.zh: 我睡前会写日记。

ex.en: Keeping a learning diary encourages students to reflect on their progress and identify difficulties.
ex.zh: 坚持写学习日记能鼓励学生反思自己的进步并发现困难。

tip: diary是日记，dairy是乳制品；注意字母顺序。

ex.en: Checking my phone before breakfast has become a habit.
ex.zh: 早餐前查看手机已经成了我的习惯。

ex.en: Developing the habit of regular exercise during childhood can improve health throughout adult life.
ex.zh: 在童年时期养成规律锻炼的习惯，可以改善整个成年阶段的健康状况。

col: get into the habit of｜养成……的习惯
tip: 表示做某事的习惯，用habit of doing。

ex.en: The panda sat quietly, chewing a fresh bamboo shoot.
ex.zh: 那只大熊猫静静地坐着，嚼着一根新鲜竹笋。

ex.en: Protecting panda habitats also benefits other species that depend on the same mountain forests for survival.
ex.zh: 保护大熊猫栖息地也有益于其他依赖同一片山林生存的物种。

tip: panda通常指大熊猫；red panda指小熊猫。

ex.en: The elephant sprayed water over its back with its trunk.
ex.zh: 大象用鼻子把水喷到自己的背上。

ex.en: Protecting elephant habitats requires cooperation between conservation organisations, local communities, and governments across national borders.
ex.zh: 保护大象栖息地需要保护组织、当地社区和各国政府开展跨国合作。

col: a herd of elephants｜一群大象
tip: 复数为elephants；象鼻用trunk，不用nose。

senses.en: a tall pink water bird with very long legs and a curved neck

ex.en: A pink flamingo is standing on one long leg by the lake.
ex.zh: 一只粉色的火烈鸟正用一条长腿站在湖边。

ex.en: A tall flamingo gets its bright pink color from the tiny shrimp it eats in lakes.
ex.zh: 高大的火烈鸟从它在湖里吃的小虾中获得鲜艳的粉红色羽毛。

col: a pink flamingo｜一只粉红火烈鸟
a flock of flamingos｜一群火烈鸟
tip: 火烈鸟复数可写成flamingos或flamingoes，日常学习中加-s更常见。

ex.en: The baby crawled across the rug towards her toy.
ex.zh: 宝宝爬过地毯，朝她的玩具爬去。

ex.en: During peak hours, traffic crawls through the city centre, increasing journey times and vehicle emissions.
ex.zh: 高峰时段，车辆在市中心缓慢行驶，增加了出行时间和尾气排放。

col: crawl on hands and knees｜手脚并用地爬
slow to a crawl｜慢至蜗行
tip: 车辆crawl指行驶极慢；爬泳常说front crawl。

senses.en: a large elephant living in parts of Asia, with smaller ears than an African elephant

ex.en: An Asian elephant uses its long trunk to drink clean water.
ex.zh: 一头亚洲象用它长长的鼻子喝干净的水。

ex.en: In Yunnan forests, scientists protect the wild Asian elephant so its babies can grow safely.
ex.zh: 在云南的森林里，科学家们保护野生亚洲象，让小象能够安全成长。

col: protect the Asian elephant｜保护亚洲象
a baby Asian elephant｜一头小亚洲象
tip: Asian首字母必须大写，修饰元音开头的单词时前面用不定冠词an。

senses.en: to give medical care or medicine to a sick or hurt person or animal

ex.en: The kind doctor will treat my sore throat with some medicine.
ex.zh: 善良的医生会用一些药来治疗我的喉咙痛。

ex.en: Vets at the animal hospital treat hurt birds and help them fly back to nature.
ex.zh: 动物医院的兽医治疗受伤的小鸟，并帮助它们飞回大自然。

col: treat an injured bird｜医治受伤的鸟
tip: 在医疗语境中作动词表示“治疗、医治”，与“对待”含义不同。

senses.en: a nose that keeps dripping liquid when you have a cold or allergy

ex.en: Pass me a tissue, please, because I have a runny nose.
ex.zh: 请递给我一张纸巾，因为我流鼻涕了。

ex.en: When winter air turns cold, children who catch a cold often get a runny nose.
ex.zh: 当冬天的空气变冷时，感冒的孩子常常会流鼻涕。

col: a bad runny nose｜严重流鼻涕
tip: runny由run双写n加y构成，表示“流鼻涕”常说have a runny nose。

ex.en: The dusty room made me cough several times.
ex.zh: 房间里的灰尘让我咳嗽了好几次。

ex.en: People with a persistent cough should seek medical advice, particularly if symptoms interfere with sleep or daily activities.
ex.zh: 持续咳嗽的人应就医咨询，尤其是在症状影响睡眠或日常活动时。

tip: gh在此发/f/；have a cough表示有咳嗽症状。

ex.en: The nurse gently wrapped a bandage around my wrist.
ex.zh: 护士轻轻地用绷带包住我的手腕。

ex.en: Employing more community nurses could improve access to healthcare for older people living in rural areas.
ex.zh: 增聘社区护士可以改善农村老年人获得医疗服务的机会。

col: nurse someone back to health｜照料某人直至康复
tip: 作动词可直接接人：nurse a patient。

senses.en: how hot or cold a person's body is

ex.en: My forehead feels hot, so Mom checks my body temperature.
ex.zh: 我的额头摸起来很烫，所以妈妈量了我的体温。

ex.en: When a student feels dizzy at school, the nurse measures their temperature with a thermometer.
ex.zh: 当学生在学校感到头晕时，校医会用体温计测量他们的体温。

tip: 单词较长可分音节记忆tem-per-a-ture，这里指人体体温。

ex.en: He stayed in bed because he had a fever.
ex.zh: 他因为发烧而卧床休息。

ex.en: A persistent fever may indicate an infection and should be assessed by a qualified healthcare professional.
ex.zh: 持续发热可能意味着感染，应由合格的医疗专业人员进行评估。

tip: 表示发烧常说have a fever，也可说have a temperature。

ex.en: She stayed in bed all weekend with the flu.
ex.zh: 她得了流感，整个周末都卧床休息。

ex.en: Annual flu vaccinations can help protect vulnerable people and reduce pressure on hospitals during winter.
ex.zh: 每年接种流感疫苗有助于保护易感人群，并减轻冬季医院的压力。

tip: flu通常不可数；英式常说have flu，美式常加the。

ex.en: The pharmacist explained how often to take the medicine.
ex.zh: 药剂师解释了这种药应该多久服用一次。

ex.en: Advances in medicine have increased life expectancy, but access to effective treatment remains unequal across regions.
ex.zh: 医学进步延长了预期寿命，但各地区获得有效治疗的机会仍不平等。

tip: 服药用take medicine；表示医学时不可数。

senses.en: to relax and not worry or rush too much

ex.en: You have a bad cold, so stay home and take it easy.
ex.zh: 你得了重感冒，所以待在家里好好休息，别太紧张。

ex.en: Before the English speaking contest starts, our teacher tells us to breathe deeply and take it easy.
ex.zh: 在英语演讲比赛开始前，老师告诉我们要深呼吸，放轻松别着急。

col: Just take it easy!｜放轻松，别着急！
take it easy today｜今天别太累了
tip: 常用于安慰生病或紧张的人，劝对方“放轻松、慢慢来、别着急”。

senses.en: to look carefully at something or someone to make sure everything is right or healthy

ex.en: Always check your homework carefully before you hand it in.
ex.zh: 交作业之前一定要仔细检查一遍。

ex.en: Every year, doctors visit our school to check our eyes, teeth, and overall health.
ex.zh: 每年医生都会来我们学校检查我们的眼睛、牙齿和整体健康状况。

col: check your homework｜检查你的作业
check my teeth｜检查我的牙齿
tip: 既可用于医生给身体“检查”，也可用于老师或自己“检查”作业。

ex.en: We go cycling beside the river every Sunday morning.
ex.zh: 我们每个星期天早上都沿河骑自行车。

ex.en: Investing in safe cycling routes can encourage commuters to choose healthier and less polluting forms of transport.
ex.zh: 投资建设安全的自行车道可以鼓励通勤者选择更健康、污染更少的交通方式。

tip: 表示这项活动时通常不可数；常说go cycling。

ex.en: The nurse brought the patient a glass of water.
ex.zh: 护士给病人端来了一杯水。

ex.en: Allowing patients to discuss treatment options can improve trust and lead to better health outcomes.
ex.zh: 让患者讨论治疗方案可以增进信任，并改善健康结果。

tip: 作名词是“患者”；作形容词常接with。

ex.en: We can reduce waste by using our leftovers.
ex.zh: 我们可以利用剩饭剩菜来减少浪费。

ex.en: Governments should invest in renewable energy to reduce carbon emissions and improve long-term energy security.
ex.zh: 政府应投资可再生能源，以减少碳排放并改善长期能源安全。

tip: reduce by接减少量；reduce to接减少后的量。

ex.en: I felt a sharp pain in my left ankle.
ex.zh: 我的左脚踝感到一阵剧痛。

ex.en: Regular exercise may reduce back pain among office workers who remain seated for long periods.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼可能减轻长时间久坐的办公室职员的背痛。

tip: 泛指疼痛常不可数；具体一阵疼痛可用a pain。

ex.en: After treatment, her injured ankle felt much better.
ex.zh: 经过治疗，她受伤的脚踝感觉好多了。

ex.en: Access to affordable medical treatment is essential for reducing health inequalities between wealthy and disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 获得负担得起的医疗服务，对于缩小富裕社区与弱势社区之间的健康差距至关重要。

tip: 泛指治疗通常不可数；指具体疗法时可用a treatment。

senses.en: done accidentally without planning or meaning to do it

ex.en: Sorry, I took your blue pencil box home by mistake.
ex.zh: 抱歉，我不小心把你的蓝色铅笔盒拿回家了。

ex.en: During the art project, Sam put salt into his paint cup instead of sugar by mistake.
ex.zh: 在美术课手工时，萨姆不小心把盐放进了颜料杯而不是糖。

col: take it by mistake｜误拿了它
do something by mistake｜无意中做错事
open the wrong door by mistake｜不小心开错了门
tip: 固定介词短语，只能用by不能用in或with，常放在句子末尾。

ex.en: My aunt is recovering well after her knee operation.
ex.zh: 我姑姑膝盖手术后恢复得很好。

ex.en: The successful operation of public transport systems depends on reliable funding and careful long-term planning.
ex.zh: 公共交通系统的成功运作有赖于可靠的资金支持和周密的长期规划。

tip: 手术部位用on连接：an operation on the knee。

ex.en: The doctor listened carefully as I described my symptoms.
ex.zh: 我描述症状时，医生认真地听着。

ex.en: Governments should train more doctors to ensure that rural communities have reliable access to healthcare.
ex.zh: 政府应培养更多医生，确保农村社区能够稳定获得医疗服务。

col: a doctor of philosophy｜哲学博士
tip: 看医生常说see a doctor；动词doctor可指篡改。

senses.en: happening on three separate occasions during each single day

ex.en: The doctor told me to take this medicine three times a day.
ex.zh: 医生告诉我这种药一天吃三次。

ex.en: To keep our classroom air clean and fresh, we open the windows three times a day.
ex.zh: 为了保持教室空气清新洁净，我们一天开窗通风三次。

col: take medicine three times a day｜一天吃三次药
brush teeth three times a day｜一天刷三次牙
tip: time作“次数”讲时是可数名词，两次以上要用复数times。

senses.en: to measure how hot my body is using a thermometer

ex.en: I feel cold and tired, so Mom will take my temperature.
ex.zh: 我觉得又冷又累，所以妈妈要给我量体温。

ex.en: When I went to the school clinic with a headache, the nurse used a thermometer to take my temperature.
ex.zh: 当我因为头痛去学校医务室时，护士用体温计给我量了体温。

col: help me take my temperature｜帮我量体温
need to take my temperature｜需要量我的体温
tip: “量体温”的固定动词是take，中间的my可根据人称换成your/his等。

ex.en: Cooking dinner for twelve guests was quite a challenge.
ex.zh: 给十二位客人做晚饭真是个不小的挑战。

ex.en: Providing affordable housing remains a major challenge for cities experiencing rapid population growth and rising land prices.
ex.zh: 对于人口快速增长、地价不断上涨的城市而言，提供可负担住房仍是一项重大挑战。

col: meet a challenge｜成功应对挑战
challenge someone to a contest｜向某人发起比赛挑战
tip: challenge作动词可直接接观点，表示质疑。

ex.en: It is impossible to fit this sofa through the doorway.
ex.zh: 这张沙发根本无法从门口搬进去。

ex.en: Without reliable public transport, it is almost impossible for some rural residents to access essential services.
ex.zh: 没有可靠的公共交通，一些农村居民几乎无法获得基本服务。

col: impossible task｜不可能完成的任务
make it impossible to｜使……无法做到
tip: 常用it is impossible to do，表示不可能做某事。

ex.en: I'm willing to help you move this weekend.
ex.zh: 我愿意这周末帮你搬家。

ex.en: Consumers may be more willing to buy sustainable products if prices remain affordable and information is clear.
ex.zh: 如果价格仍可负担且信息清晰，消费者可能更愿意购买可持续产品。

col: be willing to do something｜愿意做某事
a willing volunteer｜热心的志愿者
a willing helper｜乐于帮忙的人
tip: 常用be willing to do，表示愿意，不等于将要。

senses.en: the strong determination in your mind to do something difficult and not give up

ex.en: With strong will, Amy finally learned to ride her bike.
ex.zh: 凭借坚强的意志，埃米终于学会了骑自行车。

ex.en: Climbing to the top of the high mountain takes both strong legs and great will.
ex.zh: 爬上那座高山的顶峰既需要强壮的双腿，也需要坚定的毅力。

col: a will to win｜必胜的决心
show great will｜展现出极大的毅力
tip: 这里will作名词意为“意志、毅力”，区别于表示“将要”的助动词will。

ex.en: After several attempts, I succeeded in fixing the lamp.
ex.zh: 尝试了几次后，我终于把灯修好了。

ex.en: Students are more likely to succeed when schools provide consistent feedback and practical support.
ex.zh: 学校持续提供反馈和实际支持时，学生更有可能取得成功。

col: succeed in doing something｜成功做成某事
succeed as a manager｜作为经理取得成功
succeed someone as chair｜接替某人担任主席
tip: 表示成功做成某事，用succeed in doing，不用to do。

ex.en: After weeks of practice, I felt confident on stage.
ex.zh: 经过几周练习，我站在台上时感到很自信。

ex.en: Students become more confident when teachers provide constructive feedback and opportunities to practise new skills.
ex.zh: 当教师提供建设性反馈和练习新技能的机会时，学生会变得更自信。

col: confident about the future｜对未来有信心
tip: confident是形容词；confidence是名词。
